description.zh:
是否返回子任务。  
取值：true，false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to return subtasks.\
Valid values: true and false.

description.zh:
指定返回迁移任务的数量。  
取值：大于0小于等于1000  
默认值：1000
description.en:
Specifies the number of migration tasks to be returned.\
Valid values: 0 - 1000 (excluding 0).\
Default value: 1000.

description.zh:
设定从该marker之后列举迁移任务。  
默认值：无
description.en:
The marker after which the migration tasks are listed.\
By default, this parameter is left empty.

description.zh: 父任务名称。指定该参数时，会返回所有该父任务的子任务。
description.en: The name of the parent task. If this parameter is specified, all subtasks of the parent task are returned.

descriptions.zh: - 列举迁移任务，您必须有mgw:ListImportJob权限。
descriptions.en: *   To query a list of migration tasks, you must have the permission on mgw:ListImportJob.
